comment: R-em3d24-4b. Upstream's build script with --disable-GUI, over the distribution's own development packages (openEMS's install/requirements page). The remedy is that page's list for this distribution.
layoutNote: Built from source by upstream's own script with an absolute install prefix, which CMake writes into the libraries' paths: it cannot be moved after it is built, so the home is built in place and published by writing its record last.
